newMediaRecord.representedDate: An artistic representation of early Tomioka mill work. A particular shift, individual identities and the exact moment represented are unestablished; this is not a photographic exposure date or a measured survey.
newMediaRecord.place: Tomioka, Gunma, Japan, depicted workplace; catalogue publisher in Tokyo. No artist visit or measured room geometry established.
newMediaRecord.material: Color woodblock print (nishiki-e), three-sheet composition; modern digital reproduction
newMediaRecord.alt: Published woodblock-print interior with two receding rows of people and reeling equipment on either side of a central passage. Brick walls, windows and repeated blue roof supports enclose the scene; the supplied composition retains visible divisions between its three sheets. This is an artistic depiction, not a photograph.
newMediaRecord.caption: Ichiyōsai Kuniteru’s print arranges workers and equipment in two rows beneath repeated roof supports. NDL catalogues this impression as [1872]; MAFF dates a comparable impression 1873 without establishing the NDL copy’s date. The published depiction supports observation of its drawn arrangement, not a measured floor plan or a photograph of every shift. Individual identities, working hours and freedom remain unestablished; modern digitization date unstated.
newMediaRecord.printCaption: Published interior depiction, NDL attribution [1872]. Workers and equipment form two rows. This is not a photograph or measured plan; a comparable MAFF impression dated 1873 does not independently date this copy.
notice: Find the two rows of workers and equipment and the passage between them.
